title: Tiny, tiny, tiny.
text: Tiny, tiny, tiny.. I thought it would be small, but it looks like it belongs on a charm bracelet. Not an ornament even on a tiny tree. I returned it.

features: Miniature Christmas tree ornament measures 0.5" W x 0.75" H x 0.5" D.
